title: Conclusion
content_filter: no >=25-word verbatim from Calleja; all quotations confined to <=24-word fragments or paraphrased

outline.subsection: (unnamed opening) — second-person experiential vignette + suspension-of-disbelief diagnosis + cybernetic-looping thesis
moves: (M1) Second-person recap of first-hours-with-a-new-game: mechanics adaptation, exploratory navigation, cognitive map formation, scripted-narrative reception, multiplayer chat onboarding — mirrors Intro's autobiographical-experiential register and rehearses kinesthetic/spatial/narrative/shared/ludic dimensions in compressed form without naming them.

(M2) Diagnosis: the common gloss 'willing suspension of disbelief' fits poorly because in games belief is enacted rather than withheld — created through action, movement, navigation, communication (lines 6314-6315). Coleridgean trope dismissed without theorist-citation.

(M3) Replacement thesis: belief in game worlds is sustained through the cybernetic looping of simulation and imagination (line 6325); imagination has an existence outside the player's mind in the digitally materialized world (lines 6328-6331).

(M4) Re-derivation of incorporation: combining imagined-habitation with validation-of-location yields incorporation rather than mere disbelief-suspension; the game environment shifts from space-of-puppet-manipulation to place-continuous-with-everyday-haunts (lines 6335-6340).

(M5) Phenomenological gesture: the experiential state has a phenomenology with specificities that bear further scrutiny (lines 6345-6346). NOTE: this is the chapter's single most leveraged future-research invitation, surfaced without naming any phenomenologist.

outline.subsection: Implications — tripartite reframing, here/there critique, decoupling-play, Genette analogy, first-considered-step positioning
moves: (M6) Volume-level summary: tripartite media-object / player / sociocultural-context reframing displaces typical binaries (game/nongame, work/play, real/virtual) by emphasizing mediated interactivity (lines 6348-6357).

(M7) Here/there critique of immersion + presence: both metaphors imply a physical reality replaced by a virtual one in a here/there dichotomy that misrepresents everyday being (lines 6362-6376). Incorporation supplants the dichotomy with a coextensive-with-physical-being framing.

(M8) Reality-stratification caveat: distinguishing actual nature of reality from human perception of reality, and refusing the physical real as the stable comparator (lines 6371-6376) — a quiet but consequential metaphysical move.

(M9) Decoupling-play diagnosis: accurate analysis of player involvement requires decoupling play from media-objects currently called games (lines 6391-6392) — a future-research charge with media-archaeological reach.

(M10) GENETTE ANALOGY (load-bearing reflexive frame): Narrative Discourse (1980) cited as exemplar of an incisive structural model that nonetheless required revision; Narrative Discourse Revisited (1988) cited as the revision-vehicle (lines 6393-6403). The Proust À la recherche du temps perdu cited as the model's analytic target. Calleja disclaims that the present volume requires immediate revision but uses Genette to license the structural-then-revisable arc.
(M11) Structuralism-challenged-by-poststructuralism passage (lines 6411-6415): poststructuralism's greater attentiveness to elements undoing taxonomy is invoked as canonical successor-trajectory.

(M12) First-considered-step positioning (lines 6426-6430): the volume is a first considered step toward more evolved and sensitive modeling — flawed but essential at this stage. THIS IS THE VOLUME'S EXPLICIT REFLEXIVE FRAME and the dissertation's strongest single positioning leverage point.

outline.subsection: Imagining Worlds into Being — collective co-production, cultural-historical arc, peroration
moves: (M13) Collective co-production: game experience is shaped by design-team resources AND by player participation AND, to a limited degree, by AI behavior (lines 6432-6444). Player co-modulation of designer-intended experience.

(M14) Cultural-historical arc of imagined-world transmission: spoken-word imagined worlds within proximal communities -> writing/print -> mechanical moving-image -> networked digital simulation (lines 6445-6452). The volume situates digital games at the latest stage of a long media-historical sequence.
(M15) Mutual-inhabitation peroration: today we inhabit each other's creations and witness others inhabiting our own (lines 6452-6453).

(M16) Incorporation-as-sought-after-experience peroration: spans calm pleasures (watching a sunset together) to high-arousal play (FPS adrenaline, jet-piloting through a gorge) (lines 6457-6462). Incorporation positioned as increasingly sought across designers/consumers/technologists.
(M17) Closing meta-claim: the variety of media-objects offering incorporation is evidence of complex human needs and interests these simulations engage (lines 6463-6465). p.186 blank.

concepts.label: structural-modelling-as-first-step
concepts.definition: Calleja's self-positioning of PIM as a first considered step toward more evolved and sensitive modeling of player involvement (book p.184, lines 6426-6430). The structural-modelling stance is held provisionally: incisive enough to be worth building, but expressly invitational of refinement, revision, and eventual outgrowth.
concepts.centrality_note: Volume-pillar reflexive frame. Strongest dissertation-positioning leverage in the chapter.

concepts.label: phenomenological-scrutiny-as-future-research
concepts.definition: The future-research thesis that the experiential state characteristic of game engagement has a phenomenology with specificities that bear further scrutiny (book p.182, lines 6343-6346). Stated without naming any phenomenologist; Calleja's residual-phenomenological register surfaces uncited.
concepts.centrality_note: The single most directly dissertation-licensing line in the volume for Layer-A Aristotelian/Heideggerian augmentation.

concepts.label: decoupling-play-from-media-objects
concepts.definition: Calleja's future-research diagnosis that accurate analysis of player involvement requires decoupling play from the media objects currently called games (book p.184, lines 6390-6392). A media-archaeological charge: the category 'game' should not over-determine what counts as play.

concepts.label: imagined-worlds-cultural-historical-arc
concepts.definition: The genealogical sequence (spoken word in proximal community -> writing/print -> mechanical moving image -> networked digital simulation) Calleja uses to situate digital games as the latest stage of an ancient transmission practice of shared imagined worlds (book p.185, lines 6445-6453).

concepts.label: structural-to-poststructural-successor-arc
concepts.definition: The literary-theory precedent Calleja invokes whereby structuralism's analytic tools are completed and overtaken by poststructuralism's greater attentiveness to elements that undo taxonomy (book p.184, lines 6411-6415). Used as the canonical trajectory licensing PIM's eventual outgrowth.

concepts.label: cybernetic-looping-of-simulation-and-imagination
concepts.definition: Calleja's compressed restatement of incorporation: belief in game worlds is sustained through a feedback loop between computational simulation and player imagination (book p.182, lines 6323-6330). Imagination has an existence outside the player's mind in the digitally materialized world.

concepts.label: suspension-of-disbelief-displaced
concepts.definition: The Coleridgean trope is dismissed as ill-fitting for digital games because belief is enacted through action/movement/navigation/communication rather than withheld (book pp.181-182, lines 6309-6318). Coleridge is unnamed; the trope is treated as common currency rather than as a theorist-citation.

concepts.label: here-there-dichotomy-critique
concepts.definition: Immersion and presence are charged with implying a physical-reality-replaced-by-virtual-world dichotomy that misrepresents our everyday mode of being (book p.183, lines 6362-6370). Incorporation supplants the dichotomy with a coextensive-with-physical-being framing.

concepts.label: tripartite-media-player-sociocultural-reframing
concepts.definition: The volume's organizing tripartite frame (media object / player / sociocultural context) is restated as the construct that displaces game/nongame, work/play, real/virtual binaries by emphasizing mediated interactivity (book pp.182-183, lines 6348-6357).

concepts.label: place-continuous-with-everyday-haunts
concepts.definition: Calleja's gloss on what incorporation accomplishes: the game environment shifts from a space-of-external-puppet-manipulation to a place continuous with the haunts of everyday life (book p.182, lines 6338-6340). Evokes Heideggerian everyday-being-with-equipment without naming Zuhandenheit.

concepts.label: belief-created-through-action
concepts.definition: The Conclusion's most compressed action-as-constitutive claim: belief in game worlds is created through action, movement, navigation, communication, and other forms of interaction (book p.181, lines 6314-6315). Direct candidate for aisthesis-kinesis bridge.

concepts.label: reality-stratification-caveat
concepts.definition: Calleja distinguishes actual nature of reality from human perception of reality and refuses to take the physical-real as stable comparator to which virtual phenomena are measured up (book p.183, lines 6371-6376). A quiet metaphysical move embedded in the immersion critique.

concepts.label: model-revision-as-canonical-trajectory
concepts.definition: The Genette case is invoked to license the structural-modelling-then-revision arc as the canonical trajectory for any incisive analytic apparatus (book pp.183-184, lines 6393-6420). Even Genette's incisive narrative-time taxonomy required revision via Narrative Discourse Revisited (1988).

concepts.label: collective-co-production-of-experience
concepts.definition: Multiplayer game experience is shaped jointly by designer resources, player participation, and (to a limited degree) AI behavior; players modulate designer-intended experience (book pp.184-185, lines 6432-6444).

concepts.label: mutual-inhabitation-peroration
concepts.definition: Closing image: today we inhabit each other's creations and witness others inhabiting our own (book p.185, lines 6452-6453). The cultural-historical arc's contemporary terminus.

concepts.label: incorporation-as-sought-after-experience
concepts.definition: Incorporation positioned as increasingly sought across designers/consumers/technologists, with arousal-spectrum range from calm pleasures (sunset with friends) to high-intensity play (competitive FPS, jet-piloting) (book p.185, lines 6457-6462).

concepts.label: rhetorical-bookending-meta
concepts.definition: The Conclusion opens with a second-person experiential vignette mirroring the Intro's autobiographical opening and closes with a cultural-historical peroration. The rhetorical bookending is itself a meta-textual signal of the volume's design.

positions.label: Calleja: PIM is a first considered step, not a closed system; future refinement and eventual poststructural successor models are explicitly invited
positions.rationale: Explicit volume-level self-positioning. The 'first considered step' phrase is the chapter's reflexive frame and the strongest single license for adaptation/extension work on PIM.

positions.label: Calleja: the phenomenology of game-engagement experience bears further scrutiny — without naming any phenomenologist
positions.rationale: Direct future-research invitation that the dissertation's Layer-A Aristotelian/Heideggerian augmentation can claim as Calleja-licensed. The phrasing 'phenomenology... that bear further scrutiny' is itself residually phenomenological in register despite no classical-phenomenological cite.

positions.label: Calleja: incorporation displaces immersion/presence's here/there dichotomy by being coextensive with physical being
positions.rationale: Conclusion-level restatement of IG-10's central move, in distilled here/there terms suitable for downstream citation.

positions.label: Calleja: accurate analysis of player involvement requires decoupling play from the media-objects currently called games
positions.rationale: Future-research charge with media-archaeological reach. The category 'game' should not over-determine what counts as play; the construct 'play' must be capable of analysis across present and future media-objects.

positions.label: Calleja: the structural-to-poststructural arc in literary theory is the canonical trajectory licensing PIM's eventual outgrowth
positions.rationale: Genette analogy generalizes to a programmatic statement: structuralism's tools must come first to make possible the later, more attentive analytics that supersede them.

positions.label: DISSERTATION POSITIONING (anticipatory): the dissertation occupies precisely the successor-position Calleja anticipates — its Aristotelian/Heideggerian augmentation is the kind of refinement Calleja's future-research agenda licenses
positions.rationale: This position is not Calleja's claim. It is the dissertation's reading of two passages — 'first considered step' + 'phenomenology that bears further scrutiny' — that together supply Calleja-attested license for the dissertation's adaptation-and-extension work without Calleja naming any successor framework.

tensions.label: Provisional structural-modelling commitment vs. critique of taxonomy-resistant phenomena
tensions.description: Calleja concedes that models are analytical constructs lacking suppleness for complex phenomena bearing on subjectivity and consciousness (lines 6406-6411), yet defends structural modelling as the necessary first stage (lines 6416-6420). The tension is not a contradiction but a productive provisional commitment: structural modelling holds until poststructural attentiveness becomes possible.

tensions.label: Phenomenological register without phenomenological apparatus
tensions.description: The Conclusion's residual-phenomenology language ('phenomenology... that bear further scrutiny', 'experiential state characteristic of engagement') invokes a phenomenological register without any classical-phenomenological cite (no Husserl, Merleau-Ponty, or Heidegger named; Heidegger's sole volume-cite is in IG-02 p.21). The tension is between the line's evident phenomenological appeal and the chapter's complete absence of phenomenological theoretical apparatus.

tensions.label: Decoupling-play from games vs. games-as-the-volume's-object
tensions.description: Calleja calls for decoupling the notion of play from media-objects currently called games (lines 6390-6392), yet the volume's analytic apparatus has been developed THROUGH analysis of present-day games (MMORPGs, FPSs, etc.). Tension is between the agenda's media-historical reach and the apparatus's media-present grounding.

game_loci_note: ZERO games-by-name in the chapter, confirmed against fulltext lines 6291-6465. Per Phase 1 metadata. Generic references only ('a new digital game', 'multiplayer FPS', 'competitive FPS match', 'piloting a speeding jet through a gorge'). Specific game references are confined to the dimension chapters and the Appendix.

interlocutors.name: Gérard Genette
interlocutors.depth_of_treatment: load-bearing analogical anchor (sole named interlocutor in the chapter)
interlocutors.engagement_note: Genette serves as the model-revision exemplar: Narrative Discourse (1980) — the structuralist analysis of narrative time in Proust's À la recherche du temps perdu — required revision and response to criticism, published as Narrative Discourse Revisited (1988). Calleja disclaims that this volume immediately needs revision but uses the Genette case to license the structural-then-revisable arc as the canonical trajectory for any incisive analytic model. The structuralism / poststructuralism distinction (lines 6411-6415) is treated as literary-theory precedent legitimating PIM as 'a first considered step' (line 6426). Capture as a multi-edge cluster covering: (a) Genette/Proust/Narrative Discourse anchor; (b) Narrative Discourse Revisited revision-move; (c) disclaimer (no immediate revision required); (d) structuralism-challenged-by-poststructuralism passage; (e) elaboration-refinement-revision arc; (f) first-considered-step self-positioning. Note that Calleja's Ch.7 Narrative Involvement also engages Genette (focalization, narrative time); the IG-07-to-IG-11 Genette-thread is a longitudinal exegetical motif and the closest the volume comes to a theoretical-lineage self-identification.

interlocutors_note: Genette is the sole named interlocutor. Coleridge unnamed despite the 'willing suspension of disbelief' invocation (treated as common currency). No presence theorists, no narratologists beyond Genette, no experientialist-ontology theorists (Lakoff+Johnson / Damasio absent here despite IG-10 centrality), no Heidegger/Aristotle/Merleau-Ponty, no Burke, no Uexküll, no Gibson.
dimension_operational_definition: n/a — Conclusion is methodological reflection + peroration. The Conclusion does not develop any of the six PIM dimensions operationally; it presupposes them and compresses them into the second-person opening vignette (lines 6291-6308). For dimension-operational definitions see IG-03 (model) and IG-04 through IG-09 (per-dimension chapters).

candidate_augmentation_mappings.summary: All three dissertation augmentation layers (A=Aristotle/Heidegger, B=Burke, C=Uexküll) are wholly anticipatory relative to this chapter's text — Calleja names none of these traditions in the Conclusion. The Conclusion is nonetheless the volume's most dissertation-leveraged unit because its 'first considered step' + 'phenomenology bears further scrutiny' lines supply Calleja-attested LICENSE for adaptation-and-extension work even though they supply no exegetical anchors for any specific augmentation framework.

layer_a_aristotle_heidegger.dissertation_target: Layer-A Aristotelian/Heideggerian augmentation (Phantasia Cluster + BCAP + Bowin AMT corpus indices)
layer_a_aristotle_heidegger.rationale: Calleja's explicit invitation to further phenomenological scrutiny of incorporation is the STRONGEST SINGLE LAYER-A LICENSE in the volume. Even though Calleja names no phenomenologist, the residual-phenomenology register (phrasing: 'experiential state characteristic of engagement... with a phenomenology to it that has specificities that bear further scrutiny') opens precisely the analytic space the dissertation's Heideggerian/Aristotelian apparatus is built to occupy. Anchor pair Calleja-line 6343-6346 (license) + dissertation Layer-A apparatus (instrument).
The 'place continuous with the haunts of everyday lives' phrasing evokes Heideggerian everyday environmentality without naming Zuhandenheit. Candidate for BCAP-bridge.

layer_a_aristotle_heidegger.dissertation_target: aisthesis-kinesis via Bowin AMT + Phantasia Cluster (action-as-constitutive)
layer_a_aristotle_heidegger.rationale: The Conclusion's most compressed action-as-constitutive claim. Bowin's Aristotelian motion-and-time apparatus is the natural Layer-A target.

layer_b_burke.dissertation_target: Burke pentad — Act / Agent / Agency / Scene / Purpose; cybernetic looping parallels consubstantiation-via-shared-substance
layer_b_burke.rationale: The tripartite media-object/player/sociocultural-context framing maps loosely onto Burkean Scene/Agent/Agency ratios; belief-through-action maps onto pentadic Act+Agency. Wholly anticipatory — Burke is absent from the volume.

The cybernetic-looping framing's player-imagination-in-the-digital-world structure parallels Burke's consubstantiation-via-shared-substance. Flagged in the synthesis-stage Manual Section E as a candidate theoretical bridge.

layer_c_uexkull.dissertation_target: Uexküll Funktionskreis (perception-action loop) + Umwelt (bounded subjective environment)
layer_c_uexkull.rationale: Calleja's 'environment's affordances and geography' (lines 6334-6335) is candidate for Funktionskreis bridge; 'place continuous with the haunts of our everyday lives' candidate for Umwelt. PER PHASE 0 CRITICAL FINDING: Calleja's 'affordances' is generically used (no Gibson attribution), so the Uexküll bridge here CANNOT be claimed as Gibson-mediated. Singly-anchored anticipatory projection only.
layer_c_uexkull.provenance: anticipatory-projection (dissertation) [Gibson-mediated chain FALSIFIED for this unit]

future_research_as_dissertation_authoriz.summary: The Conclusion's reflexive-frame moves — 'first considered step' (line 6426) + 'phenomenology... that bear further scrutiny' (line 6345) + 'decouple play from media-objects' (line 6391) + 'more evolved and sensitive modeling' (line 6428) — collectively constitute Calleja's INVITATION TO A SUCCESSOR WORK. The dissertation's three-layer augmentation occupies precisely the position Calleja anticipates. While Calleja supplies no framework for the successor (he names no Aristotle, no Heidegger, no Burke, no Uexküll), he supplies the AUTHORIZATION-STRUCTURE for one to be developed. THE DISSERTATION'S STRONGEST CALLEJA-ATTESTED POSITIONING ARGUMENT IS THIS: the dissertation IS the kind of successor work Calleja's reflexive frame anticipates.
